remarks: Spacious & Sunny Alcove Studio Condo in secure well-managed Hayes House community in downtown Stamford. Access this unit just off the elevator in a pristine setting with concierge, fitness center, secure garage and laundry on site. New flooring, separate bedroom and dining areas, large living room, private storage, and courtyard with grills make this home ideal. Beautifully designed common areas include the lobby & hallways, gym and security desk. Pets are allowed with convenient access to four enticing parks. Great staff and management. 24 hour front doorman plus live-in building super. Heat, cooling, and hot water included in HOA. This location offers everything you need in walking distance, ample restaurants with patio seating, a vibrant social life and a variety of outdoor recreational activities. Near Metro North, I-95, parks, shopping, beach, and public transit. Please note that this unit is on the first floor but it is not at ground level. Live your best life at Hayes House.
